description: Conducciones is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The pipeline database presents detailed information on various supply pipelines in several municipalities in the province of Malaga. Each record includes the identification code, the code and name of the municipality, the sequence number, the driving material (such as fibrocement or PVC), and its current state (good, bad, etc.). Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The portal shows the English title as "Conductions" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Málaga. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/licence/CC_BY_4_0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
